method: Same host, pinned source and dependencies; disposable source/cache; one initial build; seven warm no-change refreshes and seven one-file edited refreshes with untimed restoration/equality verification; nearest-rank p95; filesystem caches not flushed. Baseline built from the commit before the artifact-split work (9e39e0c); optimized built from the tip of the artifact-split branch (257c400). Both runs used the same disposable checkout and the same manifest snapshot fingerprint. The text-sidecar byte count was measured with a separate one-shot build against the same checkout using the optimized tree's buildIndex/saveArtifact functions, since the benchmark harness does not report it.
limitations: The benchmark harness (scripts/bench/runner.ts) does not emit per-stage timings (artifactLoad, scanAndMetadata, publication); stageProfileMedianMs is omitted from this record because the harness does not report it.
The benchmark is one repository and one machine with warm filesystem caches, not a universal latency claim.

The harness's non-worker CLI wrapper enforces a 60-second child-process timeout (scripts/bench/cli.ts); the baseline tree's full seven-sample run exceeds that wall time, so both runs were invoked via the harness's own documented --worker mode directly (same arguments the wrapper would pass) rather than through the timed wrapper. No harness file was modified.

The pinned checkout referenced in the task brief no longer exists on this machine; a fresh disposable clone at the manifest revision was used instead and is not retained as an approved long-lived fixture.
workerPeakRssBytes and firstBuildMs are reported by the harness but not part of this record's required fields; see the task report for those values if needed.
